descriptions.w3d_d21a_level_load_8006d610: Level start-up loader: reads Game.NextLevel and looks up the level record (returns 0 if missing); publishes Land.File and GameLogic.CurrentScript, posts the string messages for the +64 and +52 texts and, when present, the particle file; publishes Particle.OverrideFile and (if non-empty) Land.Materials; copies the record fog range (+24, +20) to the global fog settings; reads Fog.MinRange, Fog.MaxRange and Fog.Colour; returns 1.
